value.message: Manage access policies to cryptographic module keys.
Defines the behavior when no existing rule matches an access request.
Governs internal platform code access to cryptographic keys.
Governs whether the script engine is allowed to access cryptographic keys.
Governs whether the system user is allowed to access cryptographic keys.

The global policies allow tweaking cryptographic access control at a high level, and provide ways to block scripts or allow internal platform components to access cryptographic keys. A neutral outcome (which is the default) causes the evaluator to defer to granular rules.
Policies apply at the Cryptographic Module level. You can also add overriding policies that only apply to cryptographic specifications.
Every module has a default policy that governs the access outcome when no existing policy is matched during evaluation.
The evaluator processes policies with increasing granularity level. That means scope-level polices are evaluated first, role-level policies second, script-level policies third, etc.
If a granting policy is encountered, access will be granted unless a strict reject policy overrides it.
Users that have been granted access to the selected cryptographic module.
Granular policies allow for finer-grained access control that arbitrate a decision based on the role, scope or script.
